judge.rationale: The candidate is an incomplete work-in-progress that stops after implementing schema compilation in `ToolRegistry.register`. `ToolRegistry.execute` was never updated to run the compiled validator, so 3 out of the 4 tests the candidate added in `registry.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately. Furthermore, it misses dynamic schema resolution/caching via `WeakMap`, the one-line JSDoc on `execute`, most unit tests required in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and all documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`). It also leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the repository and modifies `package.json` version directly.
